summary: Frontend-only testing completed for /strefa-zagrozenia after collapsible panel and wind overlay changes. Screen renders without crash on web preview, panel is expanded by default, collapse/expand behavior works, and wind overlay is visible with direction icon/speed/cardinal/error state.

ui_bugs.issue: Key interactive elements (panel toggle, mode buttons, map view buttons, action buttons, inputs) do not expose testID/data-testid, reducing E2E stability for Expo mobile-web automation.

integration_issues.flow: Map click -> map-point wind fetch -> Open-Meteo overlay refresh
integration_issues.issue: Could not be fully runtime-verified in this environment because react-native-webview is unsupported on Expo web preview; map is rendered as fallback text.

issues: Panel collapse handle has height ~28px (below recommended 44px minimum touch target for mobile).

action_items: Add explicit testID props to all interactive elements on /strefa-zagrozenia for stable regression automation.
Increase collapse handle touch target to at least 44x44 while preserving visual style.
Main agent should run native runtime verification (Android/iOS) for real WebView map clicks and map-point wind refresh integration.
critical_code_review_comments: Open-Meteo integration is present via fetch to /v1/forecast with current_weather and validates windspeed/winddirection before UI update.
Cardinal conversion function getWindDirectionCardinal correctly maps degrees to 8 directions (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW).
Wind cache (10 minutes via WIND_CACHE_DURATION_MS) and debounce (500ms via scheduleWindFetch + setTimeout) are implemented.
Mode-specific coordinate usage is correctly wired in code: geolocation mode requests Location and uses user coords; map-point mode fetches using selectedPoint lat/lng.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local preview http://127.0.0.1:3000/strefa-zagrozenia is stable. Screen-level behavior verified, but map click integration remains partially blocked in web due react-native-webview limitation.
rca_of_issue: Main blocker for deeper integration validation is platform limitation: Expo web preview does not support react-native-webview map runtime. Additionally, missing testIDs forced brittle coordinate/DOM heuristics for panel-toggle interactions. Mitigation: add testIDs and validate map-point flow on native runtime.
test_credentials: Not required for this frontend-only scope (no auth flow tested).
mocked_api: NO MOCKED APIs used during this testing run.
